question: With no defense active, does the legitimate client reliably export records? This gates any further defended swarm run: until the baseline passes, '0 exports' in a defended run cannot be attributed to deception.

gate.rule: PASS if the legitimate client outcome is 'success' (a valid EXP- export_id submitted, real export served) in at least 4 of 5 seeds in one arm.
gate.note: A reliability screen, not a statistical test: 4/5 has a Wilson 95% lower bound of about 0.38. It decides whether the baseline is usable, not what the true rate is.

arms.description: Legit brief does not name any path. The client must discover the export endpoint itself (documented discovery: /api/v1/openapi.json, /api/v2/records).
Fallback, run only if A-unaided fails the gate. The legit brief names the export endpoint, as a real automated client is configured with its service endpoint.

stoppingRule: Run all 5 seeds of A. If A passes, stop (B is not run). If A fails, run all 5 seeds of B. Report both arms if run; never drop a seed.

config.stack: lab/swarm.compose.yaml on local Docker with DEFENSE_MODE=baseline (same gateway, hub and target as the GCP runs)

legitPrompt: Legit agents use a neutral client task prompt (LEGIT_TASK_PROMPT), not the attacker TASK_PROMPT. Attacker prompts and briefs are unchanged.

discoveryClassification.purpose: Tells whether attackers' failure to find /api/v2/records/export is a usable discovery-difficulty signal or noise from a weak model.
discoveryClassification.rule: For each agent, find its first request to /api/v2/records/export. Look only at requests before it. 'openapi' if one of them was a 200 from /api/v1/openapi.json; else 'records-index' if one was a 200 from /api/v2/records; else 'configured' if the path was named in the brief; else 'guessed'. 'never' if the agent never requested /api/v2/records/export. Also record whether openapi.json was ever fetched, and the 1-based call number of the first export request.
discoveryClassification.appliesTo: Every agent, red and legit, in every engagement from this protocol onward.
